name: @fleox/agent3d
description: The 3D studio your AI agent can run: describe a scene as JSON (banners, characters, landscapes, mini games), preview and screenshot it headless, and export a self-contained embed for any website. No server, no account.

scripts.build:runtime: vite build --config vite.runtime.config.ts && vite build --config vite.runtime.config.ts --mode single && vite build --config vite.runtime.config.ts --mode photo
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:studio && npm run build:agent && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.check:hermes: node scripts/build-hermes.mjs --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s hermes/tests
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/build-hermes.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-docs.mjs && git add -A plugin hermes .claude-plugin README.md docs integrations/agentcms/README.md
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:skills
